detail.title: CS100 CPU Tower Stand- Alberta Maple
detail.overview: The Ant Esports CS100 is a rolling CPU tower stand built to keep a PC case off the floor, improving airflow and cutting down on dust buildup around the tower. Its 18mm thick wooden top board holds up to 70kg, giving it enough strength for even heavier full-tower builds, while four caster wheels with a bayonet locking mechanism let it move freely or lock firmly in place once positioned. The wheels rotate a full 360 degrees for easy repositioning under or beside a desk, making it simple to access the case for cleaning or upgrades. Finished in a warm Alberta Maple tone, it blends naturally into most home office setups while keeping the PC organised and protected from accidental knocks.
